_about: App crash signatures already dealt with, read by scripts/crashes.py, the digest and health.py. signature is the top AncientTrees frame as crashes.py prints it, on the store build it fired on. fix_commit / first_fixed_build: the code fix and the first build that carries it. server_remedy / contained_at: a server-side fix that stops it without a new build, and when it was applied; crashes before contained_at count as answered. A run that fixes a crash adds its entry here in the same change.
